nodes.name: NiCoP@NF phosphorization
nodes.procedure: To prepare the Co-Ni(OH)₂@NF precursor, 1.461 g of NaCl and 1.189 g of CoCl₂·6H₂O were dissolved in 50 mL of deionized water (DI) to promote the corrosion of NF. The resulting Co-Ni(OH)₂@NF was rinsed, dried, and subsequently phosphorized at 350 °C using 350 mg of NaH₂PO₂ under an N₂ atmosphere. After cooling, the NiCoP@NF was collected and preserved in a vacuum-drying oven.

nodes.name: Ce-Fe(OH)x electrodeposition on NiCoP@NF
nodes.procedure: A N₂-saturated solution was prepared by dissolving 2.02 g of Fe(NO₃)₂·9H₂O, 217.1 mg of Ce(NO₃)₂·6H₂O, and 85 mg of NaNO₃ in 50 mL of DI. The NiCoP@NF was used as the working electrode, with a platinum sheet as the counter electrode, and an Ag/AgCl electrode as the reference electrode. The Ce₀.₁-Fe(OH)x precursor was deposited onto NiCoP@NF via cyclic voltammetry (CV) electrodeposition at 65°C, with a scan rate at 50 mV s⁻¹ over a potential range of -1.2 to 0 V versus Ag/AgCl.
nodes.source_text: Electrodes Preparation—Preparation of Ce₀.₁-Fe₂P/NiCoP@NF... via cyclic voltammetry (CV) electrodeposition at 65°C, with a scan rate at 50 mV s⁻¹ over a potential range of -1.2 to 0 V versus Ag/AgCl.

nodes.name: Secondary phosphorization
nodes.procedure: Subsequently, the Ce₀.₁-Fe(OH)₂/NiCoP@NF was phosphorized using NaH₂PO₂ at 400°C for 2 h. The loading capacity of Ce₀.₁-Fe₂P was ≈12.9 mg cm⁻², determined by the gravimetric method.

nodes.description: OER performance in N2-saturated 1.0 M KOH three-electrode system

Ce_{0.1}-Fe_2P/NiCoP@NF requires overpotentials of only 257, 280, and 304 mV... Tafel slope of 55.3 mVdec^{-1}... R_ct of 1.82 Ω... C_dl value of 17.8 mF cm^{-2}... ECSA values were calculated to be 445 cm²... TOF of 2.61 s^{-1} at 1.534 V

nodes.characterization_summary: High-resolution XPS Ce 3d spectrum shows Ce^{3+} peaks at 886.0 and 903.0 eV, Ce^{4+} at 881.9, 891.5, 897.4, 914.2, and 922.3 eV. Fe 2p shows Fe^{δ+} in Fe-P at 707.1 and 720.1 eV (0.3 eV positive shift vs Fe2P/NiCoP). Ni 2p shows Ni^{δ+} in Ni-P at 853.1 and 870.3 eV. Co 2p shows Co-P at 778.3 and 793.4 eV. P 2p shows M-P bonds at 129.5 and 130.4 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the high-resolution Ce 3d spectrum (Figure 2b), peaks at 886.0 and 903.0 eV correspond to Ce^{3+}, while peaks at 881.9, 891.5, 897.4, 914.2, and 922.3 eV are attributed to Ce^{4+}. The Fe 2p spectrum ... exhibits peaks at 707.1 and 720.1 eV, corresponding to ... Fe^{δ+} in Fe-P. ... peaks at 129.5 and 130.4 eV correspond to M-P bonds in metal phosphides.

nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figure 5c,d, distinct peaks emerge for Ce_{0.1}-Fe_2P / NiCoP@NF at 1.3 V_RHE ...
